Backend Software Engineer

Fictional Harbor Services

FICTIONAL JOB DESCRIPTION FOR APP TESTING

Build and maintain Python services for an internal operations platform. Work with a platform team and participate in design reviews.

REQUIRED

- Design and test REST APIs, including validation, errors and safe handling of retries.

- Use Python and PostgreSQL to debug service behavior and query performance.

- Explain transaction boundaries and tradeoffs in service design.

- Collaborate on containerized delivery and review production issues.

NICE TO HAVE

- Kubernetes deployment familiarity.

- AWS service exposure.

INTERVIEW STAGE

Hiring manager discussion followed by a technical interview.
